title: Giving Opinions and Arguing
ringkas: Ungkapan pendapat, setuju, dan tidak setuju
goals: menanyakan pendapat: [[What do you think about ...?]], [[How do you feel about ...?]]
menyatakan pendapat: [[I think ...]], [[In my opinion, ...]], [[I believe ...]]
menyatakan **setuju**, **tidak setuju**, dan **setuju sebagian** dengan sopan
memberi alasan dengan [[because]], [[since]], [[for example]], dan [[that's why]]
memakai kata penghubung kontras: [[but]], [[however]], [[although]], [[on the other hand]]
berdebat secara santun dan menulis paragraf pendapat singkat

lesson.text: Di kelas, di media sosial, dan dalam ujian lisan, kita sering diminta berpendapat. Pendapat yang baik **jelas**, **disertai alasan**, dan **sopan** terhadap pendapat orang lain. Di unit ini kamu belajar ungkapan-ungkapan untuk itu.

lesson.title: 1. Menanyakan dan menyatakan pendapat
table: [[What do you think about online classes?]]
[[In my opinion, school uniforms are important.]]
[[I believe reading is a good habit.]]
[[As far as I'm concerned, it is too expensive.]]

lesson.title: 2. Setuju dan tidak setuju
table: [[I agree with you.]] / [[That's true.]] / [[I think so too.]]
[[You have a point, but ...]] / [[I partly agree, but ...]]
[[I'm afraid I disagree.]] / [[I see your point, but I don't think so.]]
[[I totally disagree.]] / [[I don't agree at all.]]

lesson.title: Sopan saat tidak setuju
lesson.text: Jangan langsung berkata [[No, you're wrong.]] Lebih santun: [[I see your point, but ...]] atau [[I'm afraid I disagree because ...]]. Selalu sertai **alasan**.

items.ex: In my opinion, it is a good idea.
Give a reason for your opinion.
One advantage is that it saves time.
A disadvantage is the high price.
Our class has a debate on Friday.

lesson.title: 4. Memberi alasan dan contoh
table: [[I like it because it is cheap.]]
[[It is cheap, so many people buy it.]]
[[Some apps, such as dictionaries, are useful.]]

lesson.title: 5. Menyatakan kontras
table: [[It is useful, but it is expensive.]]
[[It is useful. However, it is expensive.]]
[[Although it is expensive, I like it.]]
[[On the other hand, it saves time.]]

lesson.title: Although dan but tidak dipakai bersamaan
lesson.text: Dalam bahasa Indonesia kita bisa berkata *meskipun ..., tetapi ...*. Dalam bahasa Inggris pakai **salah satu**: [[Although it is expensive, I like it.]] atau [[It is expensive, but I like it.]]

lines.en: What do you think about school uniforms, Tom?
lines.id: Menurutmu bagaimana tentang seragam sekolah, Tom?

lines.en: In my opinion, they are important because they make all students equal.
lines.id: Menurutku seragam penting karena membuat semua siswa setara.

lines.en: I see your point, but I don't think so. Students can still be equal without uniforms.
lines.id: Aku paham maksudmu, tapi kurasa tidak. Siswa tetap bisa setara tanpa seragam.

lines.en: That's true. However, uniforms are cheaper than many different clothes.
lines.id: Itu benar. Namun, seragam lebih murah daripada banyak pakaian berbeda.

lines.en: You have a point. Maybe we partly agree.
lines.id: Kamu benar juga. Mungkin kita setuju sebagian.

lines.en: Do you think students should bring phones to school?
lines.id: Apakah menurutmu siswa boleh membawa ponsel ke sekolah?

lines.en: I think so. Phones are useful for looking up information.
lines.id: Kurasa boleh. Ponsel berguna untuk mencari informasi.

lines.en: I'm afraid I disagree. Although phones are useful, many students play games in class.
lines.id: Sayangnya aku tidak setuju. Meskipun berguna, banyak siswa bermain game di kelas.

lines.en: Good point. Maybe students can use them only for study.
lines.id: Poin bagus. Mungkin siswa boleh memakainya hanya untuk belajar.

lesson.title: Rumus paragraf pendapat
lesson.text: **Opini** (I think ...) → **Alasan 1** (because ...) → **Contoh** (for example ...) → **Sisi lain** (however ...) → **Kesimpulan** (so, in my opinion ...). Lima kalimat sudah cukup untuk paragraf pendapat yang rapi.

items: Bertanya: [[What do you think about ...?]]. Berpendapat: [[I think ...]], [[In my opinion, ...]].
Setuju: [[I agree.]]; tidak setuju sopan: [[I'm afraid I disagree.]]; sebagian: [[You have a point, but ...]].
